title: os db orphans: a detail whose controlled-by-parent master is optional is never swept for dangling master references
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytLmJxfAmgPVjUbbW

Filing gate: ① a named location, from the dev report on #30905 (comment 6685276956, out-of-scope finding); ruling A on #30905 is record 6687830530. ⛔ Not a claim.

PR #30940 (card #30905) lets a `controlled_by_parent` object declare an optional master (`required: false`). `packages/cli/src/utils/orphan-detail-sweep.ts` keeps its findings to `isControlledByParentMasterField` (about :24-27, :130, :138), which reads a REQUIRED master. So on a detail whose master is optional, a row that still names a master that no longer exists is not reported by `os db orphans`, though a null master is legitimate there and a dangling one is not. (Read, not reproduced.)

Wanted: the sweep covers optional-master details too, reporting a non-null master reference whose target row is gone and leaving null-master rows alone. A test pins both.

Suggested grade: p3, `domain:server`. Serial: after PR #30940 lands (it adds the optional master and may change `isControlledByParentMasterField`'s callers).
